title: Missing this ONE Thing in your due diligence is DEADLY
description:
When buying a business, most buyers focus on financials, contracts, and customer relationships—but there’s one critical piece that often gets overlooked in due diligence: the employee handbook. In this video, we break down why this seemingly simple document can cause major headaches post-acquisition if you ignore it. From hidden liabilities to conflicting policies, the handbook can reveal a lot more than you think.

We’ll show you what to look for, why it matters, and how missing this step could lead to employee disputes, legal issues, or culture clashes after the deal closes. Whether you're a seasoned buyer or just getting into M&A, this is one detail you can’t afford to miss.
